About Holzbaurechner

Free calculators for wood projects, so that while you are still planning you know which lumber you need and roughly what it costs.

Who is behind it

Holzbaurechner (German for “timber construction calculator”) is run by Theo-Phil Penner from Innsbruck, Austria. I am a master mason and know the questions that come up before every building project: which sizes, how many boards, what will it cost? The site started in German and now also has a metric English version for the UK, Ireland and Australia and this version in feet and inches for the United States.

How the calculators work

Each calculator starts from a common way of building the project in North America, for example a deck with a ledger board, joists in hangers and a dropped beam on 6x6 posts. From your sizes it works out every part. Where the building code has span tables, the calculator uses them: deck joists and beams come from Tables R507.6 and R507.5 of the 2021 International Residential Code (IRC). The cut list is then packed into the stock lengths you can buy, 8 to 16 ft for most lumber and up to 20 ft for 2x10s and 2x12s.

How each project is built is explained on its page, right below the calculator, so you can compare the result with your own plan.

Where the prices come from

The example prices are per linear foot at big-box home centers, checked in November 2026. Lumber prices move weekly and vary by region, store and grade. That is why every calculator has a price level field that scales all prices, and why the result is a range of ±15 %.

Where the limits are

The sizes are planning values for pricing and buying lumber. They do not replace a permit review or an engineer. Many cities and counties amend the IRC, use different snow and wind loads or require specific details. Decks, patio covers and carports usually need a permit, so check with your building department before you build.

Free and without signing up

All calculators are free. The website is funded by advertising and may contain affiliate links marked “paid link”. If you buy through one, you pay the same price and I earn a small commission. Neither ads nor commissions influence the results; the lists name no brands and no stores. What you enter stays in your browser and is not stored. Details are in the privacy policy.

Found a mistake or missing a project?

If you notice a calculation error or would like a calculator for another project, please get in touch. You will find all the ways to reach me on the contact page.
